text:
Aisha: Quick sync — planning partner onboarding for SecureVault (cloud marketplace vendor). Scope: SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM key flow, and secrets manager connector. Want to coordinate timeline for marketplace listing + a joint announcement. Who can own certs/attestations and docs?

Tom: I can take SSO/SAML and SCIM test harness. Need partner IdP metadata and test SP metadata from our side. Also: do we require SP-initiated or IdP-initiated only? @Aisha prefer SP-initiated for marketplace SSO.

Marta: Product note — marketplace listing can ship with SAML-only and SCIM as 'beta' if we flag provisioning. Joint announcement should wait until BYOK/HSM is validated. Suggest timeline: listing in 6 weeks, announcement in 10–12 weeks.

Evan: For SI enablement I'll draft a runbook + sample SCIM payload. Sample SCIM create user:
```json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName":"j.doe@example.com",
  "name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"},
  "emails":[{"value":"j.doe@example.com","primary":true}]
}
```
Also need partner contact for test tenants.

Tom: KMS/HSM questions: do they support AES-GCM key wrapping and RSA 3072 attestation? We should require HSM attestation doc and a KMS API spec. Also confirm BYOK flow and rotation window. CCing security.

Liam: Legal — we'll need 30 days review for any joint marketing copy + logos usage ok? Also need to confirm data residency claims in announcement. Please route drafts to legal@redwood.com and include partner MSA.

Aisha: Timeline proposal: marketplace listing target 2026-05-15 (6 weeks), joint announcement target 2026-07-01. Owners: SAML/SCIM=Tom, KMS/HSM=Tom+SecurityTeam, Docs/runbook=Evan, Marketing assets=Marta, Legal review=Liam. Objections?

Marta: OK from Product. I'll coordinate marketing brief and press embargo.

partner-bot: Action created: #partner-securevault-onboard, onboarding-docs template copied, reminder in 3d for progress check.

Evan: I'll ping SecureVault for dev accounts today and post contact info in the channel. Action items I'll track: 1) Get IdP metadata 2) Get test tenant 3) HSM attestation doc 4) Draft runbook.

Tom: I'll start SAML-SP metadata and SCIM endpoint scaffolding. ETA 10 business days.

Aisha: Great — please update the checklist in the channel when done. I'll set a recurring sync weekly. :thumbsup:
